episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Edward is nervous for his family's move to LA. Lacey's marriage is strained. Dee Dee and Zoe celebrate. Edward's flight departs for Los Angeles.

episodes.title: Food
episodes.summary: Lacey struggles to do anything right for Edward. Later, she meets more people affected by the crash at the first Grief Group therapy session.

episodes.title: Stuff
episodes.summary: Shay and Edward look for clues about the mystery girl. Adriana decides to run for her grandmother's seat. Dee Dee goes to LA to search for answers.

episodes.title: Chrysalis
episodes.summary: The burden of being "Miracle Boy" weighs on Edward. Adriana helps Kojo throw a Ghanaian funeral. Dee Dee unravels her husband's mystery.

episodes.title: Haunted
episodes.summary: Edward heads to the city in search of the mystery girl. John visits the crash site. Sam opens up to Lacey. Amanda is haunted by her fight with Brent.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.summary: Shay and Edward go on an adventure to find Mahira. Lacey bonds with Linda. Kojo prepares for his move back to Ghana. Dee Dee confides in Zoe.

episodes.title: Folklore
episodes.summary: Shay's father comes back into her life, leading to tension with Edward. Adriana and Kojo take Becks to the mountains. Lacey and John hit an impasse.

episodes.title: Music
episodes.summary: Edward starts acting out. Adriana seeks advice from Eric. Sam gets candid with Vernon. Dee Dee struggles with change.

episodes.title: Paper Covers Rock
episodes.summary: A discovery rattles Edward. Adriana prepares to say goodbye to Kojo. Amanda and Steve get closer.

episodes.title: Shelter
episodes.summary: Season finale. Lacey and John search for Edward. Dee Dee throws a party. Election Day comes for Adriana. Edward revisits his past.
